title: Witness UTXO that contradicts the previous transaction

wallet.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

attack: The previous transaction says the coin holds 0.05 BTC, the witness UTXO says 0.01 BTC. A signer that reads the second for the fee shows 10,000 sats.
rule: Refuse an input whose witness UTXO differs from the output it points to in the previous transaction.
